source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Navigate to the failed building(s).
3. In the Address line, copy the address and past it into the location bar, replacing what is already there. Add an apostrophe, hit some keys after the ' to make a space between the word and the ' e.g. 
![address](https://github.com/openaddresses-africa/building-streets-2017-08-20/blob/master/images/PasteAddressInTheLocationBar.JPG?raw=true)

4. Press Enter:
![enter](https://github.com/openaddresses-africa/building-streets-2017-08-20/blob/master/images/NavigateToLocationBar.JPG?raw=true)
5. Notice how OpenStreetMap already takes you to that location. You won't be able to geocode the address because you've already arrived
